title: Store Hot Path V1
description: The whole-history work a store may do on its mutation path (design §20.14): after a warm-up of plain edits, a run of local steps is measured by four counts — full folds of the event log, edits hashed into forward prefix digests, ids mirrored into the persisted cursor and revision records rebuilt. A step that only appends, grows or removes the applied tail costs O(change): no fold, one mirrored id per new stack entry and one rebuilt record per changed one, however long the history; prefix digests are hashed only where the prefix ring is seeded (a first undo past the tail snapshot), never per step.

warmup.description: Plain one-operation edits applied before measuring; the history length the measured steps run against.

kind.description: `apply`: one plain edit; `append`: one tick of the open tool transaction (the first opens it); `commit`: closes it; `undo`: undoes the applied tail; `redo`: redoes the redo top.
